instruction: Post a question about the last t-shirt I ordered on amazon, "Do these t-shirts bleed color onto other clothing items in the same wash?".
notes: Single-app task (amazon). The last-ordered t-shirt is unknown up front, so it is modeled as an abstract product object `last-tshirt-product` inside abstract order `last-tshirt-order`; static init facts (order-contains, product-has-type, last-ordered-of-type) encode the selection rule, and the lookup chain show_orders -> show_order -> show_product makes the order id, product id and product type known before write_product_question is allowed. Goal demands exactly one new ProductQuestion on that product with the given text; complete_task carries no answer (the product/question parameters are task records, not API arguments). All non-final actions require (not (task-completed)), which is only set by supervisor-complete-task.
